_comment: Serves the repo root so index.html runs as a real page rather than a file:// URL,
which it needs: the service worker, the manifest and the photo blobs all require
an origin. Static only — there is no build step, the app is the one file.
Entries naming a per-session scratchpad path are deliberately absent. Those paths
die with the session that made them, and a launch.json full of configurations that
no longer start is worse than a short one that does.
